summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: @servicetitan/uikit-docs@22.11.3 is published as a documentation-only package (package.json declares files: ["docs"] containing.mdx files) but the tarball also ships setup.mjs and math_init.js at the root, wired in via scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs". On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript blob using an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator (WV8StW/MmgoCP shift over a large numeric dictionary n7gIxM) and hex-mangled identifiers. The math_init.js name is a decoy; the file contains no math-related content. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute an opaque sibling bundle at install time evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The declared purpose (MDX documentation) has no legitimate need for a second runtime, a large obfuscated JS payload, or a preinstall hook. The mismatch between the declared "files" allowlist and the payload files actually present in the tarball is consistent with a compromised-maintainer / hijacked-version publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
